newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-NUGGETS SIGN KENNY SMITH TO 10-DAY CONTRACT. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-NUGGETS SIGN KENNY SMITH TO 10-DAY CONTRACT. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]

text.p: Veteran point guard Kenny Smith, who won two NBA championship rings with the Houston Rockets, is joining his third team of the season after signing a 10-day contract with the Denver Nuggets Friday (corrects from Thursday).

Smith began the season with Detroit after signing a one-year deal at the veteran minimum of $247,500. He averaged 2.6 points and 1.1 assists in nine games before the Pistons waived him on November 23.
The Orlando Magic signed Smith on December 17 and he averaged 2.8 points in six games, but was waived January 6 to avoid paying his contract for the rest of the season.

Smith has averaged 13 points and 5.6 assists in 704 career games over 10 NBA seasons with Sacramento, Atlanta, Houston, Detroit and Orlando. He spent six seasons with the Rockets (1991-96), starting on NBA championship teams in 1994 and 1995.
